d: North Carolina Courage host Gotham FC at WakeMed Soccer Park as NWSL play continues. First-place Gotham FC arrives after a 2-1 win over Racing Louisville, while North Carolina sits fifth after winning two of its last three games in league play.
From Robin Roberts Stadium in Springfield, Ill.

t: Elevance Health Women's Fort Myers Tip-off: Mississippi State at TCU
d: Mississippi State at TCU in the Women's Fort Myers Tip-Off.
